description: This file implements a custom HTTP server for testing purposes, including request handling, URL rewriting, SSL support, and server control functions.

classes.name: RequestRewriter
classes.description: Handles URL path rewriting based on specified rules.

classes.name: WebTestServer
classes.description: Custom threaded HTTP server supporting SSL and request routing.

classes.name: WebTestRequestHandler
classes.description: Custom request handler for processing HTTP requests, including error handling and SSL support.

classes.name: WebTestHttpd
classes.description: Encapsulates server setup, start, stop, and URL generation for testing scenarios.

methods.name: rewrite
methods.description: Rewrites request URL if a matching rule exists.

methods.name: get_request_line
methods.description: Reads and validates the request line.

methods.name: handle_connect
methods.description: Handles HTTP CONNECT method, optionally enabling SSL.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes server, request handler, and related configurations.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server, either blocking or in a separate thread.

methods.name: get_url
methods.description: Constructs a URL for accessing the server.
